Package com.im.njams.sdk.serializer

Class SerializerResult

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.serializer.SerializerResult
  • public final class SerializerResult
extends Object
    Immutable result of a size-limited serialization (see Serializer.serialize(Object, int)): the produced string together with an explicit flag telling whether the serializer had to stop early because the size limit was reached.

    The flag is the reliable signal that the output is incomplete; callers must not infer truncation from the string length, because a size-honouring serializer stops at (or near) the limit whether or not more content existed.
